notes: Puzzle leads because the buttons that toggle lava, move bridges and lock doors are the real logic of the space, and puzzle-open is precisely puzzles staged across open ground with no enclosure; the crystal gathering is the goal rather than the challenge. Adventure is named second so the lethal lava has an ID at all — its hazard-kill is worded for lava fields that punish careless traversal, and nothing in Puzzle's own table expresses a killing surface. I kept Open-Air Puzzle's shape but dropped trigger-solve and facade-clue because nothing accepts a key item and no riddle or clue wall is described, then added button-solve for the buttons and collectible-nodes for the crystals. Decided without a user: the lava lies in flat patches on the ground, so the bridges span them at grade rather than overhanging and this stays off P2; the doors are gates in the terrain rather than building entrances, so no P3; and the generated relief is hills and rock with no caves, which is tiered, on a roughly 100-by-100-stud map that ends when the last crystal is taken.
